scope: Authorized text evidence copies and this metadata only. No maintained sources, compiler runs, tests, final packet manifests, or reserved packet files modified.

completedCold237Basis.boundary: These are copies of the named completed cold04 artifacts; copying adds no independent compiler/runtime execution and does not expand the claims of the underlying records.

normalization.operation: Exact byte-level CRLF (0D 0A) to LF (0A), with one disclosed final blank LF removed from promotion237-source-readback01.json for git diff --check; all other selected bytes retained.
normalization.prefixRule: For two explicitly authorized refusal-log prefixes, select through the 40th LF or EOF first, then apply the same CRLF normalization. The ledger records full raw source hash, selected prefix byte count, and destination raw hash.
normalization.embeddedPathsAndHashLines: Copied verbatim except CRLF normalization. Historical record hash lines refer to original stage bytes, not automatically to renamed/LF-normalized packet copies. Use destinationRawSha256 in this ledger for packet-copy identity.

historicalBoundaries: fixture225-* is the historical native-values-01 evidence from fix225kernel01, not an execution of fix237.
warmseed03-* is warm seed preparation using historical runtime/support inputs, not a cold bootstrap proof.
warmseed03-LD.command preserves the initial command; warmseed03-LD02.command is the actual corrected linker attempt referenced by the copied LD-terminal.json attempt02.
failed-cold02-* preserves the actual L2 incompatible-entry-signature refusal before source-built B1.
failed-cold03-* preserves the actual strict-C backend refusal; its COMPILE log is a first-40-lines prefix, not the complete error log.
The retained native/forced root0/root1 logs are actual cold04 suite records. Their names do not prove every callee body was walked; no such expanded claim is made by copying them.

copyValidation.destinations: Explicit whitelist only; every resolved absolute target checked inside this packet directory; unique flat names; no overwrite of existing destination files.
copyValidation.sources: All 70 named source files existed, were UTF-8 decodable without NUL/UTF-16/standalone-CR issues, and full raw source hashes were unchanged after each copy.
copyValidation.copy: Initial raw Copy-Item identity verified before optional prefix/LF mechanical transformation; final bytes verified against exact normalized selected source bytes.
copyValidation.reservedFiles: notes.md, verification.json, packet.sha256, packet.list and packet-provenance.json were not opened, hashed, listed or modified by this task.
